title: NetDecoyEvent
description: Standardized schema for all events emitted by NetDecoy deception resources and processed by the intelligence engine and backend.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific event (e.g. evt_001, generated by backend if omitted).

session_id.description: Identifier grouping related attacker interactions into a single session.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp of when interaction occurred.

source_ip.description: Client IP address observed by the deception trap.

page.description: Simulated resource or decoy endpoint where the interaction took place.

action.description: Specific action performed (e.g. failed_login, endpoint_probe, query_submit, file_download, traversal_attempt, sql_injection).

event_type.description: Broad category describing the nature of the event.

payload.description: Contextual details associated with the interaction (e.g. usernames, query strings, requested paths). Must never contain real credentials.

geo.description: Geographical enrichment data (city, country, latitude, longitude, isp)
